items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Casper
items.description: Casper licenses several city-regulated business and professional activities through Community Development and the City Clerk, including contractors, mechanical and plumbing trades, utility contractors and installers, mobile-home work, water treatment, and health-related businesses; application and renewal fees vary by license class and qualification review is required before permits.

feeDetail.note: The fee depends on the type of business and license; the city or county sets it in its fee schedule.
